blocks.html: Robinsons Mall Hours on All Saints Day
For those planning to proceed to Robinsons on All Saints Day after visiting their dear departed at cemeteries, please be guided by the operating hours of Robinsons malls on November 1.

The following malls will operate on regular mall hours: Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Santiago and Summit Ridge Tagaytay.

The following malls will open at 12 noon: Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Ilocos, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Sta. Rosa and Robinsons Starmills.
For more updates on announcements, visit the official Robinsons Malls Facebook page at www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls.
